propositions: read-only derivations over durable event store must support metrics with clean event signatures: attempts-per-ticket, first-pass verification rate, rework at 7/30 days, reopen-recovery, revert-linked recovery
attempts_per_ticket and rework_within_days and reopen_recovery require raw event files because compiled state preserves only terminal values, not multi-occurrence or per-event data
first_pass_rate and revert_recovery use compiled reduce_ticket state because only terminal facts (absence of last_reopened_at, presence of substantive reverts) suffice
raw event readers must reuse existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event, RETIRED_SUFFIX) to handle file listing, sorting, and retired-event inclusion consistently
empty-range metrics return None (Unavailable in registry); populated ranges with zero qualifying events return measured 0
retired events (.retired suffix) are included in all metric calculations so history survives compaction
